pages.text: From 1.2 many single-block machines run on the same $(thing)Operation$() console as the physics multiblocks: the Chemical Reactor, the Regeneration Kiln, and most of the chemistry machines. Set the controls, read the readout, and keep the recipe inside its window. They have no containment to wear; they also take the mathematics upgrades (Rate Table, Stability Margin, Confidence Seal, Error-Correcting Code, Optimised Pathway), one of each. A coolant loop is there for those that need one (the NMR Spectrometer's magnet).
Every machine also has a $(thing)catalyst slot$() (the gold slot under its progress arrow) - see The Catalyst Slot in the Chemistry chapter.
